content:
Ben: whoa team — we just crossed `2,000,000` inference requests in a single day. that's nuts :star_struck: 
Maya: omg congrats!! :tada: been watching the dashboard all day, congrats infra + runtime
Priya: this calls for snacks. quick poll: cupcakes, empanadas, or kombucha keg? vote with emoji
Oliver: empanadas :meat_on_bone: but pls vegan option
Devon: cupcakes for the photo ops :camera_with_flash: +1 for coffee pairing
Sophia: kombucha keg is the vibe but maybe too messy for the courtyard?
Ben: empirical tie-breaker: majority emoji wins in 30m. i'll handle ordering if someone shares dietary needs.
Maya: shoutout to @Devon for the async KV cache fix that dropped median latency by ~12ms overnight. hero hours paid off :clap:
Devon: it was a dicey recompile at 1:45am, not gonna lie. huge props to Sophia for the test harness that caught a regression.
Sophia: team effort! also ops-bot reported zero error-rate blips during the surge, so yay for canaries doing their job.
ops-bot: Incident report: none. Canary evaluations: green. Auto-scale activity: +2 nodes between 08:00-10:30 PT.
Priya: logistic note: courtyard reserved 14:30-15:00. can folks bring blankets if they want to sit?
Ben: i'll bring a foldable speaker & some playlists. feel free to add recs to the thread.
Oliver: adding a 3-slide brag pack to the all-hands: perf chart, thank-yous, and a tiny note about cost per 1k tokens. anyone want to add a gif?
Maya: i'll try to make a quick looping GIF of a tiny rocket and confetti 
Devon: uploading stupid dancing gif now [giphy:dance-bot] :joy:
Priya: food poll so far: empanadas 5, cupcakes 3, kombucha 2. empanadas win. i'll order 40 with 10 vegan.
Ben: perfect. i'll bring napkins and compost bin labels. green team approved :recycle:
Sophia: tiny ask for the meetup: 5-min lightning demo on the kernel fallback and one slide on how we test rollouts. short and sweet.
Maya: love that. see you at 14:30 — quick, loud, and terribly proud :heart:
Ben: <3 see y'all.
